scope: Read-only mathematical review of parent supplied 794 visible stone-foot pixels and frozen Torren front-support walk contours. No engine, actual movement, or whole hidden-footprint certification.

registration.scope: Unselected bounded single-orange-house study. Generated hidden outer base is NEW design. Original only certifies doorway threshold band; no recovered three original corners. Roof/chimney and door silhouette checked independently.
registration.visibleFootOwnership: Each8pxstrip uses the deepest actual stone-foot sample within that strip, not a shallower ideal line; beyond stone span use edge continuation only for roof overhang support.
registration.pointerMeaning: Actual new arched door material; site33,30 and approach34,30 unchanged; no targeting generic house bbox.

thresholdComparison.meaning: Local threshold slopes are about 1.3–1.6 source pixels farther back at overlapping x. New end extensions are not source-certified jamb/outer-feet restoration.

responsibilityLimit: Coarse responsibility polygon/cell overlap is not proof of physical interpenetration. Original blue-house hidden foundation and right garden ownership must be resolved from visible material, not filled/baked by inference.
walkFacingContract: Horizontal follows deltaX; vertical may retain east or west. Both frozen walk frames checked on each applicable directed edge; conservative phase coverage, not an engine run.
limitations: Only original threshold contact band is visibly source-certified; left/right outer bases are new design.
794 footline samples and their continuous connections do not certify hidden rear volume, full ground-footprint, blue-house separation, or total original responsibility coverage.
